# Tree Builder

## Summary
`buildTree(items, parentIdOf)` turns a flat list plus a parent edge into a forest of `TreeNode { item, children }`. Items whose parent is missing become roots, and a cycle is broken rather than looped, so a bad edge in the data cannot hang a render. The Tree component re-exports both and renders `TreeNode` as its node shape.

## Usage
```ts
import { buildTree } from '@cardstack/catalog/utils/build-tree';

let roots = buildTree(employees, (e) => e.manager?.id);
```

## Non-goals
No rendering, no sorting of siblings (input order is kept), no persistence of the tree.
